$comment: What a visitor of a site built from Tracy Business (any CMS) must never read: the demo company's name in every script it ships, and the rest of its identity — domain, hotline, address, registration numbers. Read by scripts/brand-leaks.py --identity. The Joomla build's own list (packages/cms/tracy-joomla-quickstart/identity/tracy-business-j6.json) is a token map for the archive; this is the acceptance list for the site.
